Region classifications and constants
```{r}
INAUG_DATE = "2025-01-20"
WINDOW_DAYS = 60
TOTAL_DAYS_EACH_SIDE = 9*WINDOW_DAYS

get_region <- function(country){
  if (country %in% MCA){
    return("MCA")
  } else if (country %in% CARIBBEAN){
    return("CARIBBEAN")
  } else if (country %in% SA){
    return("SA")
  } else if (country %in% ASIA){
    return("ASIA")
  } else if (country %in% AFRICA){
    return("AFRICA")
  } else if (country %in% EUCA){
    return("EUCA")
  } else{
    return(NA)
  }
}
```

Create arrests dataset
```{r}
arrests <- read_dta("../data/processed/ddp_arrests_state_threat_gender_age_cleaned.dta") %>% 
  filter(ApprehensionDate >= as.Date("2023-11-27") & ApprehensionDate <= as.Date("2026-07-13"))

arrests <- arrests %>%
  filter((year(ymd(ApprehensionDate)) - birth_year) >= 18) %>% # filter out children
  select(c(ApprehensionDate, ApprehensionMethod, 
           ApprehensionCriminality, case_threat_level,
           state_clean, aor_short, citizenship_country)) %>%
  mutate(threat_level = ifelse(!is.na(case_threat_level) & case_threat_level == 1, 1, 
                               ifelse(!is.na(case_threat_level) & case_threat_level == 2, 2, 0))) %>%
  mutate(citizenship_region = unlist(lapply(citizenship_country, get_region))) %>%
  mutate(convicted = ifelse(ApprehensionCriminality == "1 Convicted Criminal", 1, 0)) %>%
  select(-c(ApprehensionMethod, ApprehensionCriminality, case_threat_level))

assign_window <- function(dates) {
  days_from_inaug = as.numeric(as.Date(dates) - as.Date(INAUG_DATE))
  window_assignment = ifelse(days_from_inaug < 0, 
                             -((-days_from_inaug - 1) %/% WINDOW_DAYS + 1), 
                             days_from_inaug %/% WINDOW_DAYS)
  window_assignment = ifelse(
    (days_from_inaug < -TOTAL_DAYS_EACH_SIDE) | (days_from_inaug > (TOTAL_DAYS_EACH_SIDE - 1)), 
    NA, 
    window_assignment
  )
  return(window_assignment)
}

arrests$window <- assign_window(arrests$ApprehensionDate)
arrests <- arrests[!is.na(arrests$window),]

# filter the arrests
arrests <- arrests %>% filter(!is.na(citizenship_region))
```

Map
```{r}
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf", type = "map_units") %>% 
  filter(geounit != "French Guiana" & name != "Guadeloupe" & iso_a3 != "BES") %>% 
  mutate(admin = toupper(admin)) %>% 
  select(admin)

world[world$admin == "SÃO TOMÉ AND PRINCIPE",]$admin = "SAO TOME AND PRINCIPE"

map_units <- ne_countries(type = "map_units", scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") %>% 
  filter(geounit == "French Guiana" | name == "Guadeloupe" | iso_a3 == "BES") %>% 
  select(geounit, geometry) %>% 
  mutate(geounit = toupper(geounit)) %>% 
  rename("admin" = "geounit")

map_units[map_units$admin == "CARIBBEAN NETHERLANDS",]$admin = "BONAIRE, SINT EUSTATIUS AND SABA"

world <- rbind(map_units, world) %>%

arrests_pre_period <- arrests %>% 
  filter(ApprehensionDate < as.Date("2025-01-20"))

  filter(ApprehensionDate >= as.Date("2025-01-20"))

# figure out missing countries
setdiff(arrests_mutated$citizenship_country, world$admin)
```
Sum arrests by citizenship country, get proportion of each country in each region
```{r}
arrests_country <- arrests_mutated %>% 
  group_by(citizenship_region) %>% 
   mutate(n_region = n()) %>%
  group_by(citizenship_country, n_region, citizenship_region) %>% 
  summarize(n_country = n()) %>% 
  mutate(prop_country_in_region = n_country/n_region)

arrests_country_pre <- arrests_mutated %>% 
  filter(window < 0) %>% 
  group_by(citizenship_region) %>% 
   mutate(n_region = n()) %>%
  group_by(citizenship_country, n_region, citizenship_region) %>% 
  summarize(n_country = n()) %>% 
  mutate(prop_country_in_region = n_country/n_region)

arrests_country_post <- arrests_mutated %>% 
  filter(window >= 0) %>% 
  group_by(citizenship_region) %>% 
   mutate(n_region = n()) %>%
  group_by(citizenship_country, n_region, citizenship_region) %>% 
  summarize(n_country = n()) %>% 
  mutate(prop_country_in_region = n_country/n_region)
```

```{r}
map_data <- world %>%
  left_join(arrests_country, by = c("admin" = "citizenship_country")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(citizenship_region))

map_data[]

all_regions <- c("Africa", "Asia", "Caribbean", "EUCA", "MCA", "SA")
other_regions <- setdiff(all_regions, "EUCA")
pal <- c("EUCA" = "darkgrey", 
         setNames(scales::brewer_pal(palette = "Dark2")(length(other_regions)), other_regions))


region_colors <- c(
  "EUCA"   = "#555",
  "Asia"   = "#D95F02",
  "Africa" = "#1B9E77",
  "Caribbean"= "#7570B3",
  "Mexico/Central America"= "#E7298A",
  "South America"= "#66A61E"
)

map_data <- map_data %>% 
  mutate(citizenship_region = case_when(
    citizenship_region == "ASIA" ~ "Asia",
    citizenship_region == "AFRICA" ~ "Africa",
    citizenship_region == "CARIBBEAN" ~ "Caribbean",
    citizenship_region == "MCA" ~ "Mexico/Central America",
    citizenship_region == "SA" ~ "South America",
    citizenship_region == "EUCA" ~ "EUCA"))

region_maxes <- map_data %>%
  group_by(citizenship_region) %>%
  summarise(max_prop = max(prop_country_in_region, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

regions <- unique(map_data$citizenship_region)

plot_list <- map(regions, function(reg) {
  reg_data <- map_data %>% filter(citizenship_region == reg)
  
  max_val <- region_maxes %>% filter(citizenship_region == reg) %>% pull(max_prop)
  base_col <- region_colors[reg]
  if (is.na(base_col)) base_col <- "#666666"
  
  ggplot(data = reg_data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = prop_country_in_region), color = "#666666", size = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#FFFFFF",
      high = base_col,
      limits = c(0, max_val),
      name = "Proportion"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste0(reg)) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray30"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm")
    )
})

final_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )
print(final_plot)
ggsave("../figures/supplement/map_by_region.pdf", height = 8, width = 7)
```

Region table
```{r}
tbl_data <- map_data %>% 
  group_by(citizenship_region) %>% 
  slice_max(order_by = prop_country_in_region, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>% 
  select(citizenship_region, admin, prop_country_in_region) %>% 
  mutate(
    admin = str_to_title(admin),
    prop_country_in_region = sprintf("%.3f", round(prop_country_in_region, 3))
  ) %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  rename(
    `Region` = citizenship_region,
    `Country` = admin,
    `Prop. in Region` = prop_country_in_region
  )

datasummary_df(
  tbl_data,
  output = "latex",
  title = "Top five countries of origin by proportion of arrests within region of origin.",
  fmt = NULL
)
```

  filter(!is.na(citizenship_region))%>%
